output.output: [{"type":"text","text":"{\"skill_id\":\"display.dark_mode_on_settings\",\"body\":\"# Turn on Dark Mode via Settings\\n\\n## Tested Environments\\n\\n- Android Settings\\n- One UI / Android 14+\\n\\n## App Context\\n\\nSettings app (com.android.settings)\\n\\n## Starting Context\\n\\nStart from any screen; navigate to Settings > Display & Touchbedienung\\n\\n## Rules\\n\\n- Use smartphone_list_elements to verify the toggle state before and after acting.\\n- The toggle may be labeled 'Dark theme' in English UI.\\n\\n## Typical Flow\\n\\n1. smartphone_open_app with package_name com.android.settings\\n2. smartphone_list_elements to find 'Display & Touchbedienung' or scroll to 'Dark theme'\\n3. smartphone_tap_coordinates on the 'Dark theme' switch to toggle it on\\n4. smartphone_list_elements to verify checked is true\\n\\n## Device Variants\\n\\n- Any Android device with stock or One UI settings\\n\\n## Verification\\n\\nConfirm 'Dark theme' switch shows checked: true via smartphone_list_elements.\\n\\n## Failure Modes\\n\\n- If 'Display & Touchbedienung' is not visible, scroll the settings list first.\\n- On some devices the path may be Settings > Display > Dark mode.\"}"}]

arguments.title: Turn on Dark Mode via Settings
arguments.description: Activates Dark Mode through Android Settings under Display & Touchbedienung.
arguments.starting_context: Start from any screen; navigate to Settings > Display & touch
rules: Use smartphone_list_elements to verify the toggle state before and after acting.
